title: BaseSurfaceRisk
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch — base/substrate non-concrete surface risk rule (5-way OR). Contract version 1.0.0, same convention as Slices 1-5. Sibling schema: base-uncertain-risk.schema.json. Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain.

BaseInput.description: The raw p.facts.base value. Matches exactly one of: 'Tarmac / asphalt', 'Hardcore / stone', 'Soil / grass', 'Existing building / structure', 'Mixed'. The legacy pre-27-Aug strings 'Stone / hardcore'/'Grass / soil' (renamed, deliberately NOT matched), 'Concrete slab', 'Not sure', empty string, null, undefined, and any other unrecognised value must all produce a null output.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when base does not match one of the 5 trigger values.

text.const: The visible surface does not by itself confirm a suitable structural foundation or slab.
